name: First-Break Picking Multi-Dataset
dataset_name: First-Break Picking SEG-Y Dataset with Masks
description: Multi-dataset first-break picking benchmark using SEG-Y amplitude records and binary step-mask labels. Models are trained on all available first-break SEG-Y pairs with gather-level train/validation/test splits and evaluated by pick-location error and hit-rate metrics.
dimensions: Brunswick, Dongbei, Halfmile, and Lalor SEG-Y pairs; 128 × 512 training patches

name: Brunswick First-Break Picking
dataset_name: First-Break Picking SEG-Y Dataset with Masks
description: Single-dataset first-break picking benchmark on the Brunswick valid SEG-Y pair. The task uses paired amplitude and step-mask SEG-Y files and reports averaged results across seeds 42, 43, and 44.

name: Dongbei First-Break Picking
description: Single-dataset first-break picking benchmark on the Dongbei SEG-Y pair. The benchmark results and model weights are public, while the raw Dongbei SEG-Y data are private and are not provided as a public download.
citation: Private Dongbei first-break picking data; public benchmark results in GeoBrain first-break picking release
